resources.string: Monitors the Samsung Settings screen so Hotspot Scheduler can turn the Mobile Hotspot on and off on your behalf. It reads and clicks the hotspot switch in Settings and nothing else.
Data cap reached, toggle failures, accessibility service health.
Used %1$s of your %2$s cap. Hotspot turned off until tomorrow.
Used %1$s of your %2$s cap, but the hotspot could not be turned off automatically. Please turn it off manually.
Couldn\'t toggle hotspot automatically — please toggle manually.
Hotspot automation cannot work until you re-enable the accessibility service.
Tap to open the Mobile Hotspot settings screen. The app will toggle the switch once it appears.
Required. Lets the app see and press the hotspot switch inside the Samsung Settings app. One UI path: Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → Hotspot Scheduler → turn On.
Required for data caps. Lets the app read how much tethering data was used today. One UI path: Settings → Apps → ⋮ (More) → Special access → Usage access → Hotspot Scheduler → Allow.
Shows the persistent status and alerts. Required on Android 13. Tap Allow in the system dialog.
Required so routine start/end times fire exactly, even in Doze. One UI path: Settings → Apps → Hotspot Scheduler → Alarms and reminders → Allow.

Prevents One UI from killing the automation. 1) Tap below to ignore battery optimizations. 2) Settings → Battery and device care → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Hotspot Scheduler. Also check Deep sleeping apps and make sure Hotspot Scheduler is NOT listed there.

Strongly recommended. Lets the app open the hotspot Settings screen by itself in the background. Without it you will get a notification to tap each time a toggle is needed. One UI path: Settings → Apps → Hotspot Scheduler → Appear on top → Allow.

One UI path: Settings → Battery and device care → Battery → Background usage limits → Put unused apps to sleep → make sure the toggle is Off, or add Hotspot Scheduler to Never sleeping apps. This is the most common reason automation silently stops after a day or two.
One-time step. Opens the Mobile Hotspot settings screen and captures every control on it so you can confirm which switch is the hotspot toggle. Do this once per One UI update.
Scanning ON — open Settings → Connections → Mobile Hotspot and Tethering now.
No saved calibration. Matching order: switch_widget id → any Switch class → Hotspot text proximity.
Tap the row that is the hotspot toggle (usually android.widget.Switch with id com.android.settings:id/switch_widget).
Use this node as the hotspot toggle?
No nodes captured yet. Tap Start calibration, or open the hotspot settings screen and tap Rescan.
No routines yet. Tap + to create one.
No usage recorded yet. Polling starts when the automation service runs.
